caption:
Soft words feel safer in the moment. They also make people miss the point.

Save this for the next talk you’re tempted to soften too much.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #feedback

messages.name: You say
messages.text: “No rush, but can you tighten this up?”

messages.name: You say
messages.text: “Maybe next time, add a little more detail.”

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “I had to fill in gaps all through this.”

slides.headline: Don’t hide the <u>point</u>.
slides.sub: Warm tone, clear words. Your team needs both.
